description: Answer an invitation: accepted, declined or tentative. Changes only your own answer. The organiser sees it on the event either way; send_updates=all also emails them.

account.description: Which account this writes to: a label from list_accounts. Required; writes have no default.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id, from list_calendars or from an agenda event's calendarId. "primary" is the account's own.

send_updates.description: Who is emailed about this change: "none" (the default), "all" guests, or "externalOnly" (guests outside the domain).

name: respond_to_invite
title: Respond to invite
